Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused my request with a credentials error ("gateway cron.list requires credentials"), so no job exists yet and nothing has been posted. Someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's credentials before I can create it. Once that's sorted, I'll set it up for Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October.

For the digest itself: #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reach anyone new. I'd leave out money terms such as rates, discounts, prices and contract values, and point to the deal desk or account owner for those.
